title: Presyncope documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports urgent cardiovascular assessment for ECG abnormality, heart failure, transient loss of consciousness during exertion, family history of sudden cardiac death, new or unexplained breathlessness, or a heart murmur.
user_facing_items.population: Adults and young people aged 16 years and older with suspected transient loss of consciousness.
user_facing_items.setting: Initial assessment, emergency transfer, referral and specialist evaluation of transient loss of consciousness.
restrictions: Exact for selected event-history, witness-account, vital-sign, cardiovascular or neurological assessment, ECG-result, urgent-risk and transfer-of-record documentation. It is international guidance and does not establish the diagnosis or UAE disposition.
user_facing_items.rationale: CG109 supports clinician documentation of event circumstances, prodrome, posture, witness information when relevant, previous events, medicines, family history, vital signs, and cardiovascular or neurological assessment; presyncope is not equated with loss of consciousness.
